panels.description: Score-threshold populations: connected gossip peers whose score is at or above each configured gate. The gates are cumulative, so the series do not add up; native all counts every connected gossip peer, and its nonnegative gate is the one libp2p labels mesh. Direct peers count by their numeric score, so this is not a count of peers whose RPCs would be accepted.
panels.title: Connected gossip peers per score threshold

panels.description: Minimum, mean and maximum gossip score of connected gossip peers; libp2p labels the mean avg. A native target without connected gossip peers has no statistics rather than zeros.
panels.title: Connected gossip peer score min / mean / max

panels.description: Peer misbehaviour reports Lodestar submitted per second, by reason. libp2p counts each report as its peer score store applies it; native counts each submission before native merges a peer's pending reports, so the native series counts submissions, not applied penalties. Native reasons outside Lodestar's fixed report names, such as sync download error messages, read as other.
panels.title: Peer bad behaviour reports submitted by reason / sec

panels.description: Every peer the native backend closes or loses, by reason: local decisions such as count_pruning or health_timeout, and remote ones such as remote_goodbye or transport_closed.
panels.title: Native peer departures by reason (per min)

panels.description: Connection attempts the native peer manager selected, by the demand that selected them, and how attempts ended. Outcomes other than connected include local policy (deferred, cancelled, admission_refused), so they are not all failures.
panels.title: Native selected attempts and their outcomes (per min)
Native current peer demand
panels.description: Whether the running node is below its peer target, and how many relevant outbound peers it lacks. Below target does not indicate chain-head starvation.
Outbound peers as a share of connected peers, per target. Both backends export the peers-by-direction gauge; the libp2p peer manager's ratio counts healthy peers only.
panels.title: Outbound share of connected peers
Native locally subscribed subnets with an empty mesh
panels.description: Counts zero-member meshes only where this node has a local subscription. Unsubscribed subnets are intentionally excluded. Each visible fork boundary is separate.

panels.title: Native remote data-column subscriptions
panels.description: Accepted remote subscription memberships include topics with no local mesh or overlay row. Advertised subscriptions are distinct from usable policy coverage.
Lookups started, and lookups finished by reason.
panels.title: Native discovery lookups (per min)

panels.description: Candidates discovery handed to peer management, and candidates it refused by reason. Candidates are decoded records, not the raw ENRs queries return; published and refused are separate stages, not a success rate.
panels.title: Native discovery candidates (per min)

panels.description: Discovery datagrams rejected while processing, by stage and reason: malformed or unexpected input, and local admission pressure. admission_limited can refuse valid traffic, including datagrams refused before decoding, until admission credits refill.
panels.title: Native discovery datagrams rejected (per min)

panels.description: Time from selecting a connection attempt to its outcome, mean and p95 by outcome. It includes local start deferrals, and a connected attempt ends at connection admission, before Status and Metadata, so this is not handshake latency. Each outcome's count equals its selected attempt outcome count.
panels.title: Native selected attempt to outcome time

panels.description: Committed mesh joins (+) and leaves (-) per second by reason; GRAFT and PRUNE controls that change no membership do not count. The backends name their reasons differently: libp2p inclusion and churn events; native joins by fill_mesh, fill_outbound, opportunistic and remote_graft, and leaves by ineligible, excess, remote_prune, local_unsubscribe, remote_unsubscribe, session_end, direct_peer and refused_graft.
panels.title: Mesh inclusion (+) / churn (-) events - sum by reason

panels.description: Gossip messages received from peers per second by topic, before duplicate filtering and validation, so duplicates and invalid messages count. Both backends; native topics outside the fixed gossip kinds read as unknown.
panels.title: Received msg / sec (log)

panels.description: Duplicates as a share of received messages per topic over 32 minutes, exactly 5 epochs; a duplicate was already seen or is awaiting validation. Both backends, each target's own counters summed across targets.

targets.expr:
sum by (topic) (
  rate(gossipsub_pre_validation_duplicate_total{topic!~"light.*"}[32m])
  or rate(lodestar_native_gossip_messages_duplicate_total{topic!~"light.*"}[32m])
)
/
sum by (topic) (
  rate(gossipsub_msg_received_prevalidation_total{topic!~"light.*"}[32m])
  or rate(lodestar_native_gossip_messages_received_total{topic!~"light.*"}[32m])
)

panels.title: Received msg duplicate share (except light_* topics)

panels.description: Messages received per nonduplicate message, per topic over 32 minutes: one plus the duplicates each message arrives with. A nonduplicate is a message's first receipt, invalid ones included, and a topic without duplicates reads 1. Both backends, each target's own counters summed across targets.

targets.expr:
sum by (topic) (
  rate(gossipsub_msg_received_prevalidation_total[32m])
  or rate(lodestar_native_gossip_messages_received_total[32m])
)
/
(
  sum by (topic) (
    rate(gossipsub_msg_received_prevalidation_total[32m])
    or rate(lodestar_native_gossip_messages_received_total[32m])
  )
  -
  (
    sum by (topic) (
      rate(gossipsub_pre_validation_duplicate_total[32m])
      or rate(lodestar_native_gossip_messages_duplicate_total[32m])
    )
    or 0 * sum by (topic) (
      rate(gossipsub_msg_received_prevalidation_total[32m])
      or rate(lodestar_native_gossip_messages_received_total[32m])
    )
  )
)

panels.title: Received msg per nonduplicate msg - by topic

panels.description: Local publications admitted to gossip per second by topic, including those without recipients; a duplicate publication does not count. Both backends.
panels.title: Published msg / sec by topic (LOG)

panels.description: Recipients each local publication was queued to. libp2p per topic; native across topics, where publications admitted without recipients count too. Queued is not delivery: native completed means QUIC accepted the final byte, not that the peer received the message.
panels.title: Published msg avg recipients queued per publication

panels.description: Sampled IWANT promises: one message id per IWANT request, broken when no peer delivers it before the deadline; broken counts on both backends. Native arms a promise when the request's send completes with its sample outstanding, and local cancellation can remove one before it expires. Broken / armed is a ratio of sampled promises, not peer delivery reliability.
panels.title: Sampled IWANT promises broken / armed

panels.description: Messages whose applied validation verdict was accept, per topic. Both backends; the received VALID panel counts prevalidation instead.
panels.title: Accepted msg / sec by topic (log)

panels.description: Share of applied verdicts per topic over 32 minutes, exactly 5 epochs. Both backends; the async validation result panel divides by prevalidated messages instead.

targets.expr:
sum by (topic) (rate(gossipsub_ignored_messages_total[32m]))
/
sum by (topic) (
  label_replace(rate(gossipsub_accepted_messages_total[32m]), "verdict", "accepted", "", "")
  or label_replace(rate(gossipsub_ignored_messages_total[32m]), "verdict", "ignored", "", "")
  or label_replace(rate(gossipsub_rejected_messages_total[32m]), "verdict", "rejected", "", "")
)

sum by (topic) (rate(gossipsub_rejected_messages_total[32m]))
/
sum by (topic) (
  label_replace(rate(gossipsub_accepted_messages_total[32m]), "verdict", "accepted", "", "")
  or label_replace(rate(gossipsub_ignored_messages_total[32m]), "verdict", "ignored", "", "")
  or label_replace(rate(gossipsub_rejected_messages_total[32m]), "verdict", "rejected", "", "")
)

panels.title: Applied verdicts - IGNORE / REJECT shares

panels.description: Score-threshold populations of the distinct peers in any mesh, the union across topics: those whose score is at or above each configured gate. The gates are cumulative, so the series do not add up, and all counts every mesh peer. Not per topic, unlike the libp2p mesh score panels.
panels.title: Native mesh peers per score threshold

panels.description: Minimum, mean and maximum gossip score of the distinct peers in any mesh, not per topic. No statistics while no peer is in a mesh, rather than zeros.
panels.title: Native mesh peer score min / mean / max

panels.description: Behaviour penalty units applied to peers per second, by protocol violation: GRAFT during backoff or flooding, broken IWANT promises, malformed RPCs and frames, and large frame timeouts. Applied units, not the decaying score value; local receive pressure never counts. libp2p's score penalties panel also counts message deficits and IP colocation.
panels.title: Native P7 behaviour penalties by violation / sec

panels.description: Recipients selected for local publications and forwarded messages, by outcome. completed means QUIC accepted the final byte, not that the peer received the message.
panels.title: Native publication and forwarding QUIC-acceptance funnel / sec

panels.description: Recipients queued for forwarding, per accepted message forwarded to at least one recipient.
panels.title: Native forward recipients queued per forwarded message

panels.description: IWANT message ids the native backend queued for sending, and those it could not serve: history misses, refusals, limits and suppressions.
panels.title: Native IWANT message ids by outcome / sec

panels.description: Messages holding a validation slot, against the pool capacity.
panels.title: Native gossip validation slots

panels.description: Receive pages in use against their capacity, and message store pages in use.
panels.title: Native gossip receive and store pages

panels.description: Delivery descriptors in use against the pool capacity.
panels.title: Native gossip delivery descriptors

panels.description: Outgoing gossip bytes queued for sending.
panels.title: Native outgoing gossip bytes queued

panels.description: Messages admitted and queued for Lodestar validation, per kind. Messages waiting on a dependency are in the next panel.
panels.title: Native queued gossip work by kind

panels.description: waiting: messages held until their block root is known. checking: messages awaiting Lodestar's dependency answer.
panels.title: Native dependency-waiting gossip work by kind

panels.description: Messages executing on the host, as a share of each kind's execution item credits.
panels.title: Native execution credit use by kind

panels.description: Messages refused admission: by the processor per kind, where ineligible means outside the eligible slot window or on an unknown fork digest, not only past-slot; and by gossipsub storage pool limits.
panels.title: Native gossip admission refusals by reason (per slot)

panels.description: Inbound requests the native backend refused for local capacity, by method and reason.
panels.title: Native local request admission refusals / sec

panels.description: Outgoing requests that could not open a stream before the dial timeout. Both backends; other dial failures are among the outgoing error reasons.
panels.title: Outgoing request dial timeouts / sec

panels.description: Serving entries in use, retiring entries included; entries retiring after their stream ended while host work finishes; and serving capacity.
panels.title: Native serving entries

panels.description: Host serving allowance still charged, retiring leases included, and source reads outstanding. Reservations, not allocated memory; source is part of total, so do not add the scopes.
panels.title: Native host serving reservations

panels.description: Open QUIC connections, handshakes included, and the handshakes among them. Do not add the two.
panels.title: Native QUIC connections

panels.description: Authenticated connections by direction, and closes by direction and reason, handshake failures included.
panels.title: Native QUIC connections established and closed (per min)

panels.description: UDP bytes the native QUIC transport received and sent.
panels.title: Native QUIC UDP traffic

panels.description: UDP datagrams the native QUIC transport received and sent.
panels.title: Native QUIC UDP datagrams

panels.description: Datagrams the kernel dropped at native sockets, per socket role and address family.
panels.title: Native UDP socket receive drops

panels.description: Native socket buffer sizes as getsockopt reports them. Linux reports double the size it granted, which the system limits can cap below the size requested, as it counts its bookkeeping overhead.
panels.title: Native UDP socket buffers (kernel-reported)

panels.description: Time per native owner loop step. It is not heartbeat lateness or event loop lag.
panels.title: Native owner step duration

panels.description: Owner loop step time accumulated per second of wall time.
panels.title: Native owner busy share
Native metrics export freshness
panels.description: Age of the native network owner's last metrics update. It uses Prometheus time, so it keeps growing if the owner stalls.

title: Lodestar native network
description: Native network peers, discovery, gossip, reqresp, transport and resource use.
